thesis: In the supplied synthetic filing, revenue and diluted EPS each grew about 11% from the prior year, and cash exceeded debt. The supplied close of 100 is 20 times reported diluted EPS. The growth and net cash support a measured simulated entry.
uncertainty: Both observations are synthetic and their origin is unauthenticated. One year-over-year comparison leaves growth durability and fair valuation uncertain.
allocation_reasoning: Buying 100 shares at the cited close of 100 plus the 1 fill fee puts 10001, or 10.001% of the 100000 cost-basis denominator, into ACME. That is below the 25% position cap and leaves 89999 in cash, above the 20000 minimum. The position size reflects the limited evidence.

exit_conditions.text: Exit the simulated position if a subsequent filing shows year-over-year declines in both revenue and diluted EPS, or shows debt exceeding cash.
